facts: SpecialCardReward inherits Reward, not CardReward; Populate is empty and has no card reward alternatives
SwipePower.BeforeDeath passes the original stolen DeckVersion to SpecialCardReward
SpecialCardReward.OnSelect adds that exact card model back to the deck; ordinary deck-entry hooks can still act
Silver Crucible/Silken Tress/Wing Charm/CardReward upgrades and Paels Wing/Driftwood alternatives do not act on SpecialCardReward
scope: Returned physical cards, not all custom fixed-card factories; source-derived tests, no installed-game parity claim
